sources.title: Enzyme function prediction using contrastive learning | Science
sources.snippet: In this work, we report a ML model named CLEAN (contrastive learning–enabled enzyme annotation) for enzyme function prediction. CLEAN was trained on high-quality data from UniProt, taking amino acid sequence as input and outputting a list of enzyme functions (EC numbers as the example) ranked by the likelihood.
